description: M17 anatomy iteration 2 after real Android screenshot review. The first body is a BLOCKY mannequin, far from the realistic human character sheet; accept only compile-safe geometrical revisions with visible impact. Review and merge manually after Java and emulator test.

tasks.goal: Modify only HumanAnatomy.java. Make ONE small, legal mathematical change to existing loft ring width or depth values that narrows blocky deltoids and smooths human upper arm attachment (no new methods or braces, no replacement of build(), do not edit armor). The preview shows detached block-shaped shoulders. Preserve all method signatures and Java syntax; copy a short exact existing line.

Make ONE small compile-safe parameter change in SurfaceAtlas.java that improves non-metallic skin readability or matte roughness while preserving steel/cloth/stone/leather legacy atlas and existing Java tests. Do not recreate or replace an entire class, do not invent new methods.

Review only: animation AI proposal passed compilation but only added constant -10 degrees elbow and was NOT promoted; realistic human weight-shift needs actual skin rig, not a blind constant offset. Do not change old Bellwarden gameplay.

Make ONE small compile-safe ModelStudio.java change improving camera framing when item==11 (HUMAN BASE). Preserve the current model item order and final IMPORTED OBJ. Do not add/remove items or change controls or replace the whole class.
Plan stable connected zone streaming framework for a future 250-zone world, no giant initial asset load; maintain deterministic generation and preserve current arena.
Plan enemies with full-body telegraphed attacks: windup commitment contact recovery, heavy slash thrust overhead grab and ranged magic; do not alter gameplay until test validation.
